 The academic calendar outlines four main school holiday periods for Group A and B schools, alongside additional days off for major celebrations.
 Malaysia's 2027 academic calendar divides schools into two groups, with the first group covering Kedah, Kelantan, and Terengganu, and the second covering the remaining states and federal territories. 
 Both groups will begin the school year on 4 January 2027 (Monday), with four main holiday periods scheduled throughout the year. 
 2027 school holiday dates for Group A 
 Group A: Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu. 
 The school year will begin on 4 January and run until 31 December, with the following breaks: 
 School holiday Dates 
 First term break 5-13 March 2027 
 Mid-year break 21 May-5 June 2027 
 Second term break 27 August-4 September 2027 
 Year-end break 3-31 December 2027 
 2027 school holiday dates for Group B 
 Group B: Johor, Melaka, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak, Perlis, Penang, Sabah, Sarawak, Selangor, Kuala Lumpur, Labuan, and Putrajaya. 
 The school year will also start on 4 January, with the following holiday periods: 
 School holiday Dates 
 First term break 6-14 March 2027 
 Mid-year break 22 May-6 June 2027 
 Second term break 28 August-5 September 2027 
 Year-end break 4-31 December 2027 
 Additional school holidays for festive celebrations in 2027 
 Beyond the four main holiday periods, the academic calendar also sets out additional days off for pupils around major festive celebrations. The dates vary between Group A and Group B, as well as between certain states. 
 Chinese New Year 
 Chinese New Year falls on 6 and 7 February 2027 (Saturday and Sunday). 
 For Group A , schools in Kedah will have additional holidays from 9-11 February (Tuesday to Thursday), while those in Kelantan and Terengganu will observe an additional break from 8-11 February (Monday to Thursday). 
 For Group B, the additional school holidays will fall on 5 February (Friday) and 9-12 February (Tuesday to Friday). 
 Hari Raya Aidilfitri 
 Hari Raya Aidilfitri falls on 10 and 11 March 2027 (Wednesday and Thursday). 
Group A schools will have an additional school holiday on 14 March (Sunday). No additional school holiday is listed for Group B . 
 Hari Raya Aidiladha 
 Hari Raya Aidiladha falls on 17 and 18 May 2027 (Monday and Tuesday), with the additional school holidays differing by state. 
 For Group A , schools in Kedah will observe additional holidays on 16 May (Sunday), 18 May (Tuesday) and 19 May (Wednesday). Schools in Kelantan and Terengganu will have additional holidays on 16 and 19 May (Sunday and Wednesday). 
 For Group B , the additional holidays will fall on 18 and 19 May (Tuesday and Wednesday). 
 Wesak Day 
 Wesak Day falls on 20 May 2027 (Thursday). Group B schools will have an additional school holiday on 21 May (Friday). 
 Deepavali 
Deepavali falls on 28 October 2027 (Thursday), except in Sarawak. 
 Group A schools will have an additional holiday on 27 October (Wednesday). 
 For Group B , schools in all states except Sarawak will observe additional holidays on 27 October (Wednesday) and 29 October (Friday). Schools in Sarawak will instead have an additional holiday on 28 October (Thursday). 
 Other festive holidays in Malaysia's 2027 school calendar 
 The 2027 academic calendar also lists several other festive dates that fall within the scheduled school holidays. 
 These include Hari Raya Aidilfitri (Hari Raya Puasa) on 10 and 11 March 2027, which falls within the first term break. 
 Pesta Kaamatan (Harvest Festival) , celebrated in Sabah and the Federal Territory of Labuan, will take place on 30 and 31 May, during the mid-year school holidays. Meanwhile, Hari Gawai Dayak (Dayak Gawai Day) on 1 and 2 June will be observed in Sarawak, also within the mid-year break. 
 Christmas Day , which falls on 25 December, is similarly within the year-end school holidays. 
 With the 2027 academic calendar outlining the main term dates and additional festive breaks, families can start planning childcare arrangements, holidays and other commitments ahead of the new school year.
